result.title: ToWo-VTON: Take-Off Wear-On Virtual Try-On via Topology-aware Decoupling
result.summary: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to synthesize garment transfer without physical trials. Although recent methods perform well on upper-body garments, they still struggle in lower-body and full-body scenarios with complex occlusions and large silhouette changes. To address this limitation, we introduce ToWo (Take-Off Wear-On), a two-stage paradigm that decouples body structure estimation from garment synthesis. Take-Off first generates a tight-fitting body proxy that provides estimated structural guidance, and Wear-On then synthesizes the target garment conditioned on this prior. This decoupling reduces source-garment interference, supporting garment placement under substantial silhouette variations. Built on this paradigm, we propose ToWo-VTON, a unified topology-aware framework with structure-aware supervision. We construct the Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC) dataset via body-aware diffusion and VLM-based filtering to provide body-proxy supervision across upper-, lower-, and full-body cases. We instantiate ToWo-VTON on both diffusion-based and MLLM-guided backbones. For diffusion-based models, we fine-tune on BFDC using the body proxy as the person input. For the MLLM-guided model, we use native backbone conditioning for the body proxy and target garment, and add Garment Boosting Attention (GBA) to preserve garment details. Experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode demonstrate improvements over the evaluated baselines, with KID reductions of 26.1% and 58.6% for diffusion-based and MLLM-guided implementations, respectively. The combined BFDC-training and Take-Off/Wear-On strategy also produces more coherent limb layouts and garment boundaries across the evaluated garment categories.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ToWo 两阶段虚拟试衣范式，先用「Take-Off」估计紧身人体代理结构，再以该先验条件的「Wear-On」合成目标服装，并构建 BFDC 数据集、在扩散与 MLLM 骨干上实例化。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于服装图像合成与试衣应用，虽用到 MLLM 骨干与结构先验条件，但目标是生成逼真试衣图，未涉及 latent 推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，缺少可借鉴的推理机制线索。
